description: This file defines a class `Smarty_Internal_Runtime_GetIncludePath` which manages include paths for the Smarty templating engine, including caching and resolving full file paths within include directories.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_GetIncludePath
classes.description: A class responsible for managing include paths, including caching include directory paths, resolving full file paths, and tracking include stream status for the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: isNewIncludePath
methods.description: Checks if the PHP include path has been updated; if so, updates internal directory caches accordingly.

methods.name: getIncludePathDirs
methods.description: Returns the list of include path directories, updating if the include path has changed.

methods.name: getIncludePath
methods.description: Resolves the full file path for a given file name within provided directories, utilizing caching and stream resolution if available.
